test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following provisions is provided in the cylinder head during design for increasing the air cooling effect?

options.text: Dimple like shapes on surfaces are provided on the cylinder walls.
Fins or extended surfaces are provided on the cylinder walls and cylinder blocks.
Cylinder block is provided with high speed cooling air flow.
Cylinder head is provided with water jackets.

solution:
The correct answer is __Fins or extended surfaces are provided on the cylinder walls and cylinder blocks.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fins__ or extended surfaces are provided to increase the heat dissipation area.
 
• The larger surface area allows for better air cooling of the cylinder head and block.
 
• Fins are commonly used in engines where air cooling is employed, such as motorcycles and small engines.
 
• The design of the fins ensures that they maximize airflow and heat transfer efficiency.
 
• Providing fins is a cost-effective and efficient cooling mechanism compared to other methods in specific applications.
 
• Fins are generally made of materials like aluminum due to their high thermal conductivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dimple-like shapes:**

 
 
• These are generally used to reduce drag in aerodynamics and are not common for cylinder cooling.
 
 
 
• **High-speed cooling air flow:**
 
 
• This requires additional components like fans or blowers and is less efficient than fins for passive cooling.
 
 
 
• **Water jackets:**
 
 
• These are used in liquid-cooled engines and are not applicable for air cooling.
